scope: ordinary-real E6 carrier branch 27 + bar27, audited through Spin(10) x U(1)_psi and Pati-Salam for reality, anomalies, exotic masses, invariant tensors, breaking, oriented support and the typed portal line

conventions.chargeConvention: 27 = 16_1 + 10_-2 + 1_4; simultaneous reversal gives the equivalent convention
conventions.independentFieldBoundary: 27 + bar27 may mean 54 independent all-left Weyl states or an ordinary-real/Nambu carrier in which bar27 is the J-image; those interpretations have different spectrum counts

twentySeven.role: colour-sextet real branch; Standard-Model exotic triplet pair after further restriction
bidoublet; vectorlike weak-doublet pair after further restriction
extra neutral singlet under the semisimple subgroup

barTwentySeven.role: J-paired copy of the self-conjugate semisimple representation
J-paired copy of the self-conjugate semisimple representation

ordinaryReality.commutant: End_E6(27 + bar27) = C + C because 27 and bar27 are inequivalent complex irreducibles
ordinaryReality.decision: SAT for ordinary antilinear reality on 54; UNSAT for an E6-equivariant linear oriented transporter between the two sheets

anomalies.reason: E6 has no primitive symmetric rank-three adjoint invariant; its representations have vanishing four-dimensional triangle anomaly
anomalies.fullCarrier: 27 + bar27 is vectorlike and locally anomaly free; notably, one chiral 27 already passes the four-dimensional perturbative E6 test, the displayed local subgroup traces and the Pati-Salam Witten-parity checks
anomalies.scopeBoundary: no claim is made here about disconnected-extension anomalies or every possible global anomaly after further quotient choices

invariantTensors.oneFamilyAntisymmetric351Channel: absent for two identical fermion multiplets; it requires antisymmetric family data

exoticMassAudit.unbrokenE6SingletMassSpectrum: one singlet bilinear coefficient masses 16 with bar16, 10 with 10, and 1 with 1 together
exoticMassAudit.independentWeylInterpretation: with only one 27 + bar27, setting the 16-bar16 eigenvalue to zero leaves both a family and a mirror massless; a single vectorlike pair cannot lift only the mirror
exoticMassAudit.nambuInterpretation: if bar27 is only the J-image, it is not an independent mirror family, but vectorlike bilinears cannot then be counted as removal of independent exotics; the physical-field quotient must be declared
exoticMassAudit.qualification: additional chiral copies, boundary/orbifold projection, compositeness, or a non-field correspondence interpretation can reopen the spectrum problem

requiredStages: select Spin(10) x U(1)_psi or Pati-Salam inside E6 using an E6-breaking vacuum such as a 78_H or 650_H direction
break the extra U(1)_psi and descend through Pati-Salam with semisimple-singlet/high-scale directions
supply the right-Majorana (10,1,3) inside the Spin(10) bar126 branch of 351-prime_H
supply an electroweak (1,2,2) direction in a Spin(10) 10 branch
split coloured (6,1,1) partners from the desired weak bidoublet
declare how the independent-Weyl mirror is removed or why the conjugate sheet is only a J-image
symmetryBreaking.minimalRenormalizableE6Precedent: 27_H + bar27_H + 351-prime_H + bar351-prime_H can break E6 directly, but this is a full vacuum system rather than a consequence of the 54-state carrier

orientedCorrespondence.sixteenLabelEmbedding: the 16 labels can be identified with 16_1 inside 27 after a Spin(10) x U(1)_psi direction is chosen
orientedCorrespondence.reason: 27 is irreducible, so an E6-equivariant idempotent on it has rank 0 or 27, never 16
orientedCorrespondence.jImage: the selected 16_1 is carried to bar16_-1 in bar27, producing two ordinary-real relation sheets
orientedCorrespondence.supportVerdict: the E6 action and cubic do not preserve the selected sixteen-state edge mask; selecting the mask requires broken-subgroup projectors and further support data
orientedCorrespondence.linearOrientedTransporterVerdict: UNSAT at unbroken E6 because Hom_E6(27,bar27)=0

typedPortalWardLine.bestNearMiss: one 27_F 27_F 351-prime_H invariant gives fixed Clebsches multiplying both the Spin(10) 10_H Dirac branch and bar126_H Majorana branch
typedPortalWardLine.missingEquality: c_10 v_10 Z_D = c_126 v_126 Z_M is not implied by the existence of the common parent coefficient Y
typedPortalWardLine.multiFamilyCost: Y becomes a symmetric family matrix, so selected entries are not one-dimensional without a family intertwiner
typedPortalWardLine.jOrCpEffect: J or CP relates the conjugate invariant and complex-conjugates coefficients; it does not exchange the Dirac and Majorana Pati-Salam operator complexes
typedPortalWardLine.wardDecision: SAT for one parent invariant coefficient with fixed Clebsch projections; no broken-phase portal ray or selected normalized portal Ward line is derived

spin23Status.positive: the 54-state carrier supplies an honest ordinary-real two-sheet target on which Spin(2,3)-organized grading and relation data could act
spin23Status.negative: no audited Spin(2,3) action selects the 16 inside 27, removes the 10+1 support, provides Hom_E6(27,bar27), or locks the two broken-phase portal normalizations
spin23Status.nextGate: construct a declared physical quotient/projection plus a broken-phase scalar vacuum and show that its surviving counterterm module is one-dimensional

verdict.programmeConsequence: 27 + bar27 is an ordinary-real exceptional container and the one-family 351-prime channel supplies one invariant coefficient with fixed Clebsch projections, but it neither isolates one chiral family nor preserves the oriented sixteen-state support nor derives a broken-phase Dirac/Majorana coefficient ray
